responsibility: Defines GNU-user OS builtins and dynamic-linker aliases for kFreeBSD-based GNU systems. It brands the target with __FreeBSD_kernel__ and __GLIBC__, asserts unix/posix semantics, and maps GNU_USER_DYNAMIC_LINKER macros onto the glibc dynamic-linker definitions used by the underlying architecture. This header specializes the generic GNU-user layer for the GNU-on-FreeBSD-kernel environment.
